messages:
Jorge (Support): hey @Nila, saw your ticket about intermittent decrypt failures after rotating KMS keys. which cloud and are you using envelope encryption or direct key operations?
Nila (Acme Security): aws + envelope. we use alias/prod-key, rotate weekly. about ~40k wrapped DEKs. some objects return InvalidCiphertextException, others succeed.
Jorge (Support): ok. first suspicion: encryption context mismatch or RBAC condition change. did you recently change any IAM condition or SCPs?
Nila (Acme Security): we did tighten an IAM condition on the app role last week to limit source VPCs. Could that cause only some callers to fail?
Arjun (Infra): yes — if some workers run in a different VPC or assume a different role, they may be blocked. CloudTrail will show the principal for failing Decrypt calls.
Jorge (Support): quick triage checklist I recommend: 1) check CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt failures and note the caller ARN and error reason; 2) confirm the exact encryption-context used when wrapping the DEKs; 3) verify key lifecycle (was alias swapped vs in-place rotation).
Nila (Acme Security): how do we verify encryption-context quickly? we have no central record of what context each job supplied.
Arjun (Infra): simplest: try to decrypt one of the failing ciphertexts with the same context values you believe were used, then try with no context. The error will switch between EncryptionContextMismatchException and InvalidCiphertextException.
Jorge (Support): also check for conditional policies: e.g., `Condition: StringEquals: kms:EncryptionContext:env = \"prod\"`. If some workers missed setting `env` the call will be denied.
Nila (Acme Security): got it. can Redwood run a validation against our sample blobs? we'd rather not send real data.
Jorge (Support): sure. we only need a single wrapped DEK (base64) and a short-lived role ARN we can assume to test decrypt+rewrap. we won't touch object data. send the sample in a support upload and mark it non-sensitive.
Arjun (Infra): for large-scale rewrap, two operational patterns: (A) prefer alias-stable rotation (let AWS rotate key material under same key id) so old ciphertexts remain valid; (B) if you must create a new key, run a bulk rewrap pipeline that `decrypt`s with old key and `encrypt`s with new key, with per-object idempotency markers.
Jorge (Support): sample AWS CLI steps to rewrap one DEK (slightly different form than KB):
```
# decode base64 blob -> encrypted_dek.bin
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://encrypted_dek.bin --encryption-context '{"svc":"acme","env":"prod"}' --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode > dek.bin
aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/prod-key --plaintext fileb://dek.bin --encryption-context '{"svc":"acme","env":"prod"}' --output text --query CiphertextBlob | base64 --decode > encrypted_dek_new.bin
```
Jorge (Support): for GCP the primitive names differ (wrap/unwrap with cryptoKeyVersions) and for AKV you call `wrapKey`/`unwrapKey` via the SDK. keep key soft-delete/purge-protection on Azure.
Nila (Acme Security): we have mixed runner types (Kubernetes pods and a lambda-like batch system). some use different IAM roles. that matches intermittent failures.
Arjun (Infra): yeah: ensure every principal the workers use has kms:Decrypt and that any role-assumption path keeps required session tags if the policy checks session tags.
Jorge (Support): docs note: we don't currently have a short 'how to rewrap at scale' recipe in the KB that covers cross-account and alias-swap cases. I'll file a docs task.
docs-bot: created DOCS-1147: add rewrap playbook (AWS/GCP/Azure), encryption-context debugging steps, and monitoring checklist.
Nila (Acme Security): one more operational ask: what's a safe rotation cadence? we currently rotate weekly and it's causing ops churn.
Arjun (Infra): weekly is aggressive unless you have automation that rewraps DEKs at once. Most orgs choose 90-365d for KMS keys and rotate DEKs more frequently if needed. Frequent KMS rotations increase rewrap risk and rate-limit exposure.
Jorge (Support): follow-up plan: Nila uploads 1 sample wrapped DEK + role for test. we'll run decrypt attempts, capture CloudTrail evidence of failures, and confirm whether encryption-context or IAM is root cause. then we'll propose a staged rewrap job template and monitoring counters (rewrap_success, rewrap_fails, decrypt_errors_by_reason).
deploy-bot: created support ticket SUP-4012 and scheduled a 30m validation window.
Nila (Acme Security): thanks all, uploading sample now. :)
